STEREOPHONIC has landed in London after much hype and excitement on Broadway where it garnered 13 Tony nominations during awards season — more than any other play in the award’s history. It went on to win in 5 categories, perhaps most importantly for Best Play.

Who’d have thought that a play all about music finds its strength in silence? Stereophonic (no, not connected to that band) dethroned Slave Play as the most Tony Award-nominated show of all-time last year with 13 nominations, and this titanic four-act play now has its West End premiere at the Duke of York’s Theatre.
